title: What fills the window
caption: Your messages are only a part of it.
punchline: How's the brain? Anything fried yet? I'm not done.
poll: Quick check: how full are you?

more-in-there-than-you-typed.title: More in there than you typed
more-in-there-than-you-typed.script: How's the brain? Anything fried yet? I'm not done. You have seen the window fill with your messages. But your messages are only a part of it, so the next question is what else goes in without you noticing.
